title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10600)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_10600) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10600). This Indian Standard which is identical. with ISO 2848-1974 'Modular co-ordination — Principles and rules* issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ), was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on the recommendation of the Modular Co-ordination Sectional Committee and approved by the Civil Engineering Division Council. Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard*. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
